zh-Hant: 兩隊各自建立「編號 → (列, 行)」的字典，以及一個圈選表格和一個連線計數器。
圈起一格之後，只有經過這一格的橫排、直行、對角線可能是「新完成」的連線，最多 4 條，要全部數進去。
每次廣播後，兩隊都更新完才判斷勝負：兩隊同時達到 K 要輸出 Draw，並且立刻結束。
en: For each team, build a dict from number to (row, col), a table of circled cells, and a line counter.
After circling a cell, only the row, column and diagonals through that cell can be newly completed. That is at most 4 lines, and every one of them counts.
After each announcement, update both teams before deciding the result. If both reach K at the same time, print Draw and stop.
